modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts forward over both planted soles.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts backward over both planted soles.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts left over the planted soles.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts right over the planted soles.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk lowers as both knees bend.
modes.minus: Trunk rises as both legs extend.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Trunk rolls left, with the left side lower.
modes.minus: Trunk rolls right, with the right side lower.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Trunk pitches forward over both planted soles.
modes.minus: Trunk pitches backward over both planted soles.

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Trunk turns left relative to the planted soles.
modes.minus: Trunk turns right relative to the planted soles.

modes.name: left_sole_forward
modes.plus: Free left sole moves forward.
modes.minus: Free left sole moves backward.

modes.name: right_sole_forward
modes.plus: Free right sole moves forward.
modes.minus: Free right sole moves backward.

modes.name: left_sole_up
modes.plus: Free left sole lifts high with the knee folded.
modes.minus: Free left leg extends downward from its flexed home configuration.

modes.name: left_arm_forward
modes.plus: Left arm tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Left arm tip moves backward.

modes.name: right_arm_forward
modes.plus: Right arm tip moves forward and upward.
modes.minus: Right arm tip moves backward.

modes.name: left_arm_outward
modes.plus: Left arm tip moves outward to the left and upward.
modes.minus: Left arm tip moves inward while lifting in front of the trunk.

modes.name: right_arm_outward
modes.plus: Right arm tip moves outward to the right and upward.
modes.minus: Right arm tip moves inward while lifting in front of the trunk.

modes.name: left_arm_up
modes.plus: Left arm tip rises above the shoulder.
modes.minus: Left arm tip moves downward and backward.

modes.name: right_arm_up
modes.plus: Right arm tip rises above the shoulder.
modes.minus: Right arm tip moves downward and backward.

modes.name: left_arm_sweep_left
modes.plus: Left arm tip sweeps left and backward around the shoulder.
modes.minus: Left arm tip sweeps right and backward around the shoulder.

modes.name: right_arm_sweep_right
modes.plus: Right arm tip sweeps right and backward around the shoulder.
modes.minus: Right arm tip sweeps left and backward around the shoulder.

modes.name: upper_trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Upper trunk and both arm roots turn left.
modes.minus: Upper trunk and both arm roots turn right.

modes.name: left_sole_outward
modes.plus: Free left sole moves left and upward.
modes.minus: Free left sole moves inward and upward.

modes.name: right_sole_outward
modes.plus: Free right sole moves right and upward.
modes.minus: Free right sole moves inward and upward.

modes.name: right_sole_up
modes.plus: Free right sole lifts high with the knee folded.
modes.minus: Free right leg extends downward from its flexed home configuration.
